comment: Independent hack.c witness for moving into a safe pet that is inside a wall: the debug dwarven Archeologist creates a tame xorn, which appears on an adjacent wall square, and steps into it. uhitm.c do_attack() draws its rn2(7) displacement roll and lets the step through, and test_move()'s obstacle arm returns FALSE for a hero who cannot pass walls, so domove_core() stops silently without spending the turn; she then searches once.
